name: quality
title: Quality max - deepest thinking on every stage
titleAr: أقصى جودة — أعمق تفكير في كل خطوة
description: Same shape as the task pipeline but every stage is pinned to the strongest model at its highest thinking level. Slowest and most expensive; use it for architecture-level or risky changes.

stages.title: Think & plan
stages.prompt:
Task: {TASK}

Produce the plan per your role contract. Enumerate at least two viable approaches with trade-offs before choosing. Write it to .workbench/artifacts/plan.md in the project at {PROJECT}.
stages.gateQuestion: Review the plan in plan.md - proceed with this plan?
stages.gateQuestionAr: راجع الخطة في plan.md — نكمل على الخطة دي؟
done: plan.md exists and contains all required sections (Task, Requirements, Chosen approach, Steps, Acceptance criteria, Risks)
At least two approaches were compared with an explicit reason for the chosen one

stages.title: Code analysis
stages.prompt: Analyze the codebase for the approved plan (.workbench/artifacts/plan.md) in the project at {PROJECT}. Mode 1 (task analysis). Cite file:line for every claim. Write analysis.md per your role contract.
done: analysis.md exists with impacted files, data flow with citations, patterns to follow, test landscape, and notes for coder
Every claim about existing behavior carries a file:line citation

stages.title: Implementation
stages.prompt: Implement the approved plan (.workbench/artifacts/plan.md) guided by .workbench/artifacts/analysis.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Write code-notes.md per your role contract.
done: Every plan step is implemented or its omission is explicitly justified in code-notes.md
code-notes.md exists with steps completed, deviations, and how-to-verify commands

stages.title: Test & review
stages.prompt: Verify and review the implemented change in the project at {PROJECT}. Checks output (if any) is in .workbench/artifacts/checks.md. Write review.md per your role contract and lead your reply with VERDICT: PASS or VERDICT: FAIL.
done: review.md exists with an explicit Verdict line
Every acceptance criterion is marked MET / NOT MET / NOT TESTABLE with evidence

stages.title: Debug & root-cause
stages.prompt: The tester issued FAIL. Fix the failures per .workbench/artifacts/review.md in the project at {PROJECT}. Reproduce first, fix root causes only, re-verify everything. Write/append debug.md per your role contract.
done: Every blocking finding from review.md is addressed or refuted with evidence
debug.md names the root cause, not just the symptom
All previously failing commands now pass (shown in debug.md)

stages.title: Ship & deliver
stages.prompt: The change PASSED review. Package it for the project at {PROJECT} per your role contract. Mode: {SHIP_MODE}. Write ship.md.
stages.gateQuestion: The change passed review - commit it? (and push if requested)
stages.gateQuestionAr: الشغل عدى المراجعة — أعمل commit؟ (والـ push لو مطلوب)
done: ship.md exists with summary, file list, commit message, and actions taken
